candidates.source: Fieberg, Liedtke, Poddig, Walker & Zaremba, JFQA 60(7) 2025, pp. 3116-3153, and online supplement
candidates.indicators: the 28 indicators exactly as defined in the supplement: rsi 14d (simple averages of gains/losses, as printed), stochK 14d, stochD 3d SMA of stochK, stochRSI 14d, cci 20d (constant 0.015, mean absolute deviation), sma 3/5/10/20/50/100/200d scaled by close, macd (EMA12-EMA26)/EMA12, macd_diff_signal (macd minus EMA9 of macd), volsma 3/5/10/20/50/100/200d scaled by current dollar volume, volmacd and volmacd_diff_signal on dollar volume, chaikin money flow 21d, boll_low/boll_mid/boll_high (20d SMA +/- 2 population sd, scaled by close), boll_width; EMA smoothing alpha = 1/(1+L) as printed (S p.2)
candidates.preprocessing: each indicator converted weekly to a cross-sectional rank mapped to [-0.5, 0.5]
candidates.model: CS-C-ENet: every week, univariate cross-sectional WLS regressions of next-week return on each ranked indicator (weights = size proxy); univariate coefficients averaged over the trailing 52 weeks (M = 52, the paper's stated rolling window); pooled elastic net (l1_ratio 0.5) of next-week returns on the 28 univariate forecasts over the trailing 52 weeks, lambda chosen by corrected AIC over sklearn's default 100-value lambda path; keep forecasts with positive coefficient; CTREND signal = equal-weighted mean of kept univariate forecasts
candidates.week: weeks end Sunday 23:59:59 UTC; indicators use daily bars up to the Sunday close; the portfolio formed at the Sunday close earns Monday-to-Sunday returns (implementation lag 0, as in the paper)
candidates.universe: Binance spot USDT pairs from data.binance.vision daily klines including delisted pairs; exclude stablecoins (USDC, BUSD, TUSD, USDP, DAI, FDUSD, PAX, USDS, EUR, GBP, AUD, TRY, BRL and similar fiat/stable bases) and leveraged tokens (UP, DOWN, BULL, BEAR suffixes); eligible in a week if it has >= 200 daily bars and trailing 30-day mean dollar volume >= 1,000,000 USD
candidates.substitutions: CoinMarketCap market cap (paid) replaced by trailing 30-day mean dollar volume as the size proxy for regression weights and portfolio value weights; the paper's market-cap >= $1M filter replaced by the dollar-volume filter above; risk-free rate 0
candidates.portfolio: quintiles on CTREND signal each week; long the top quintile, short the bottom, each leg value-weighted by the size proxy, 0.5 gross per leg
candidates.costs: 20 bps round trip on traded weight (protocol); short leg assumed borrowable at zero cost (as in the paper); the paper's own cost scenarios (30/40 bp one-way) reported descriptively
candidates.perturb_note: indicator lookbacks are perturbed jointly (all windows x0.8 or x1.2, rounded, minimum 2) as one parameter; the other three one at a time
candidates.null: allocation: each week the real long and short weight vectors are assigned to a random permutation of that week's eligible coins (999 draws, seed 20261011)

candidates.source: Cieslak, Morse & Vissing-Jorgensen, 'Stock Returns over the FOMC Cycle' (draft 2015-10-02), pp. 1, 4, 9, 56, 58
candidates.calendar: scheduled FOMC meetings only (Lucca-Moench Table B.1 for 1994-2011; federalreserve.gov FOMC calendars for 2012-2026); day 0 = meeting day (second day of two-day meetings); cycle days count weekdays (holidays count as days) from day -1 of the most recent scheduled meeting, resetting at each meeting's day -1
candidates.rule: hold SPY on trading days whose cycle day lies in week 0 (-1..3), week 2 (9..13), week 4 (19..23) or week 6 (29..33); cash otherwise (week 7 days and odd weeks out); position for day d is set at the close of day d-1
candidates.perturb_note: all even-week windows shifted together by one weekday earlier or later

implementation_notes.before: the single round-2 run; no real-data result computed or viewed
implementation_notes.ctrend_window: CS-C-ENet uses one trailing window of M weeks for both stages: univariate WLS coefficients averaged over the window, in-window fitted forecasts, pooled elastic net on those forecasts vs realized next-week returns, then week w's signal (paper: fixed 52-week rolling window, 52 in-sample observations). Chosen over a real-time-forecast training set because the latter needs 2M weeks and would leave ~1 year of development data on Binance listings
implementation_notes.ctrend_min_cross_section: 20 eligible coins per week (quintiles of >= 4 coins); fewer = no regression/no book that week
implementation_notes.ctrend_missing_indicator: NaN indicator for an eligible coin ranks at 0 (median)
implementation_notes.ctrend_enet: unweighted, centred, no standardisation; sklearn enet_path default grid (eps 1e-3, 100 values); AICc = n ln(RSS/n) + 2k + 2k(k+1)/(n-k-1), k = nonzero + 1; no positive coefficient => flat week
implementation_notes.ctrend_universe: 757 Binance USDT spot pairs incl. delisted; 685 after excluding stable/fiat bases and leveraged tokens (BTCUP-style only when the prefix is itself a listed base)
implementation_notes.ctrend_g8: crypto-only independence (corr with crypto trend core <= 0.5); SPY correlation reported descriptively
implementation_notes.fomc_calendar: federalreserve.gov historical pages 1994-2020 and fomccalendars 2021-2026 (263 scheduled meetings; cancelled 2020-03-17/18 and unscheduled calls excluded); days before 1994-02-03 have no cycle (no signal)
implementation_notes.fomc_shift: perturbation shifts every meeting by +/-1 weekday and applies the base rule
